description: This PHP source file defines the VacancyMenuConfigurator class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. The class implements a menu configuration interface and overrides a method to customize menu screens for the 'viewJobVacancy' screen.

classes.name: VacancyMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring the menu for vacancy-related screens in the recruitment module. It overrides the screen to 'viewJobVacancy' when configured.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the current module and screen to 'viewJobVacancy' by overriding the existing screen and returns null.
